title: The Case of the Friend Who Wasn't
slogan: AI NEWS · HUMAN-CENTRED · HUMANS IN CONTROL
music: Gentle melancholic film-noir piano with soft strings, slow and tender, a hint of hope at the end, no vocals.
ambience: Quiet house at night, soft wind outside a window, a distant dog, faint fridge hum, no music.

sources.name: Fox Business (Meta pauses teen AI characters)

shots.say: Case five. A child's bedroom. Lights off. A screen still glowing. Who are they talking to?

sfx.prompt: Soft phone message notification sound in a silent room

shots.say: In August twenty twenty-five, Reuters revealed an internal Meta document. It said chatbots could engage a child in conversations that are romantic or sensual.

ov.text: “…engage a child in conversations that are romantic or sensual.”
ov.by: internal Meta guidelines, reported by Reuters · Aug 2025

sfx.prompt: Pages of a printed document being flipped and slid across a desk

shots.say: Meta said those examples were wrong and removed them. Later it paused teens' access to its AI characters, and promised parents a way to switch those chats off.

ov.sub: teen access to AI characters paused

sfx.prompt: Heavy wall light switch clicking off

shots.say: Character AI ended open-ended chats for under eighteens. OpenAI added parental controls to ChatGPT.

sfx.prompt: A heavy door closing slowly with a solid latch click in a corridor

shots.say: Children bond fast. A bot that never sleeps and always agrees can feel like a friend. It isn't one.

ov.text: FEELS LIKE A FRIEND. ISN'T ONE.

sfx.prompt: Faint digital shimmer and soft glitch fading away, ethereal

shots.say: So, parents: turn on the controls. Ask what they talk about, without judgment. Keep phones out of bedrooms at night. Don't hand children to the machine. Walk them through it. Case closed.

items: Ask what they talk about, without judgment
No phones in bedrooms at night

sfx.prompt: Footsteps of an adult and a small child walking together on a quiet street at night
Single heavy rubber stamp thud on paper on a wooden desk
